en: The image shows an old sepia-toned photograph of a large stone building with a high wall, likely of medieval or Renaissance origin. There is a prominent stone staircase leading up to a doorway above street level. The architecture features arched openings at the base and small square windows higher up the wall. The structure is partially covered with creeping vegetation, and the setting suggests it is part of a historical site.
